sloka: पितुः समीपं गच्छन्तं प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात् ।स तं कैलासशृङ्गाभं प्रासादं नरपुङ्गवः ॥२-३-३१॥
transliteration: pituḥ samīpaṁ gacchantaṁ prāñjaliḥ pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt ।sa taṁ kailāsaśṛṅgābhaṁ prāsādaṁ narapuṅgavaḥ ॥2-3-31॥

translations.english: ﻿ Best among men, Rama accompanied by charioteer Sumantra ascended that palace that was lofty as the peak of Kailasa mountain in order to see the king.
